how_it_was_done.obstacle_1: The image page renders inside a Wujie micro-frontend (<wujie-app class='wujie_iframe'> with shadowRoot). Selector queries against the top document return nothing; elementFromPoint resolves to the WUJIE-APP host only.
how_it_was_done.obstacle_2: The dialog's 确定/取消 buttons read as box [0,0,0,0] in the shadow tree while the visible ones live in a same-origin iframe.
how_it_was_done.solution: Drive the same-origin iframe at https://www.dcs.cloud/images/ directly: enumerate inputs, write values via the iframe realm's native value setter + InputEvent, and use its CodeMirror instance for the Bash-instruction tab.
how_it_was_done.obstacle_3: The form only allows ONE tool-package row (the 添加 button disappears after the first row), so the 7 pinned packages were entered through the Bash指令 tab instead.
how_it_was_done.obstacle_4: The Bash指令 editor is CodeMirror; assigning to the underlying textarea does nothing. Set it via document.querySelector('.CodeMirror').CodeMirror.setValue(...).
